cli.help.text:
Local IP intelligence: country, ASN, and organization.

Commands print a compact terminal view. Pass `--json` (or set LOOKING_GLASS_JSON=1)
for the machine JSON dump. A single lookup is one object; `--file` or `-`
writes one JSON object per line (JSONL) when `--json` is set.

 
Get started:
  looking-glass build
  looking-glass validate
  looking-glass lookup 1.1.1.1
  looking-glass dns example.com DS
  looking-glass lookup --file ips.txt
  looking-glass lookup bench 1.1.1.1
  looking-glass docs
  looking-glass lookup-server start
  looking-glass wall block ip 203.0.113.0/24
  looking-glass wall list ip
  looking-glass --json wall list

Datasets live in ~/.looking-glass/data. Build once, then look up as many IPs as you want.
The intel server (lookup-server) uses a Unix socket in that same directory.

cli.https.help.text:
Start, stop, inspect, or renew the looking-glass HTTPS supervisor.

TLS listens on http.port (default 5555) for IPv4 and IPv6 (http.bind default *).
Pin one family with `looking-glass config set http.bind 0.0.0.0` or `::`.
Let's Encrypt HTTP-01 uses http.acme_port (default 80). Enable with
`looking-glass config set http.enabled true` after setting hostname (email is optional).
The intel server is a separate Unix socket.

The intel server is a separate Unix socket.

cli.lookup.query.help.text:
Look up an IP, ASN, country code, or DNS name.

One query prints a compact terminal view (JSON with `--json`). `--file` or
`-` (stdin) prints one short line per query, or JSONL with `--json`.
The kind is detected from the token. IPs and country codes use the
intel server when it is running; a country dump includes every RIR CIDR.
Names that are not an IP, ASN, or country are DNS lookups (`--type`, default A).
RBL results cache 24 hours.
cli.lookup.query.help.en:
Look up an IP, ASN, country code, or DNS name.

One query prints a compact terminal view (JSON with `--json`). `--file` or
`-` (stdin) prints one short line per query, or JSONL with `--json`.
The kind is detected from the token. IPs and country codes use the
intel server when it is running; a country dump includes every RIR CIDR.
Names that are not an IP, ASN, or country are DNS lookups (`--type`, default A).
RBL results cache 24 hours.

cli.whois.help.en: Registration data. RDAP by default; --legacy for classic WHOIS.

cli.whois.opt.legacy.text: Use port-43 WHOIS instead of RDAP.
cli.whois.opt.legacy.en: Use port-43 WHOIS instead of RDAP.

docs.cli_intro.text: Every command prints JSON on stdout. The GUI is not required. looking-glass ip talks to the intel server (looking-glass lookup-server start), not the website. Select a block to copy.
docs.cli_intro.en: Every command prints JSON on stdout. The GUI is not required. looking-glass ip talks to the intel server (looking-glass lookup-server start), not the website. Select a block to copy.

docs.gui_intro.text: The index is a tabbed form surface. Each form builds an HTTP path (toolPath) and shows curl / HTTPie / looking-glass howto as you type. Full-page HTML reports use the same paintInspect renderer. Inspect cards on IPs/domains open extra tools; ASN clicks go to RDAP.
docs.gui_intro.en: The index is a tabbed form surface. Each form builds an HTTP path (toolPath) and shows curl / HTTPie / looking-glass howto as you type. Full-page HTML reports use the same paintInspect renderer. Inspect cards on IPs/domains open extra tools; ASN clicks go to RDAP.

docs.http.cache-clear.notes.text: 401 without a session. Filenames use basename; ns in {rdap,bgp}.
docs.http.cache-clear.notes.en: 401 without a session. Filenames use basename; ns in {rdap,bgp}.

docs.http.cache.notes.text: 401 unless a PAM admin session is present.
docs.http.cache.notes.en: 401 unless a PAM admin session is present.

docs.http.config.notes.text: 401 without a session. auth.users cannot be set here; use looking-glass auth users.
docs.http.config.notes.en: 401 without a session. auth.users cannot be set here; use looking-glass auth users.

docs.http.config.summary.en: Operator config.json. POST sets dotted keys (docs.enabled, locale, cache, refresh, wall, history).

docs.http.dns.notes.en: normalize_qname + canonicalize_qtype. ?server= is an IP only. CLI --timeout is not an HTTP query param.

docs.http.dns.summary.en: DNS lookup. Optional /<type> (A, AAAA, MX, DS, …).

docs.http.dnssec.summary.en: Walk DS/DNSKEY from the IANA root anchors.

docs.http.dnstrace.summary.en: Iterative walk from the IANA root. Optional /<type>.

docs.http.docs-regen.summary.en: Rebuild the documentation file from the catalog.

docs.http.docs.notes.text: Off by default (docs.enabled). When disabled, GET /docs is 404. Reads ~/.looking-glass/data/docs.html and injects live session chrome. Does not regenerate on GET.

docs.http.docs.summary.text: This documentation (file written by looking-glass docs).
docs.http.docs.summary.en: This documentation (file written by looking-glass docs).

docs.http.history.notes.text: GET /history lists every successful lookup and needs a session. GET /history/<id> is a shareable permalink (JSON or HTML) and does not.
docs.http.history.notes.en: GET /history lists every successful lookup and needs a session. GET /history/<id> is a shareable permalink (JSON or HTML) and does not.

docs.http.history.summary.text: Logged-in global action list. Also /history/<id> for replay JSON or HTML.
docs.http.history.summary.en: Logged-in global action list. Also /history/<id> for replay JSON or HTML.

docs.http.http.notes.en: Connects to the named host (open lookup / SSRF if the server can reach private nets).

docs.http.http.summary.text: Follow redirects; headers, HTTP version, TTFB.
docs.http.http.summary.en: Follow redirects; headers, HTTP version, TTFB.

docs.http.login.accept.text: JSON. Sets an HttpOnly looking_glass_session cookie (opaque file session, not a JWT).
docs.http.login.accept.en: JSON. Sets an HttpOnly looking_glass_session cookie (opaque file session, not a JWT).

docs.http.login.notes.text: Root is never allowed. Body is JSON or form username/password.
docs.http.login.notes.en: Root is never allowed. Body is JSON or form username/password.

docs.http.login.summary.text: PAM login. First non-root user bootstraps the allowlist.
docs.http.login.summary.en: PAM login. First non-root user bootstraps the allowlist.

docs.http.logout.summary.text: End the GUI session and clear the cookie.
docs.http.logout.summary.en: End the GUI session and clear the cookie.

docs.http.logs-stats.notes.text: 401 without a session. 15-minute snapshots for the last 24h (day) and 7d (week); stored buckets only, no zero fill.
docs.http.logs-stats.notes.en: 401 without a session. 15-minute snapshots for the last 24h (day) and 7d (week); stored buckets only, no zero fill.

docs.http.logs-stats.summary.text: Per-page hit/error time series for the log viewer charts.
docs.http.logs-stats.summary.en: Per-page hit/error time series for the log viewer charts.

docs.http.logs.notes.text: 401 without a session. kind=access|error|login|lookup|serve-err|wall|build (serve-out is an alias of lookup). ok=true|false filters login.
docs.http.logs.notes.en: 401 without a session. kind=access|error|login|lookup|serve-err|wall|build (serve-out is an alias of lookup). ok=true|false filters login.

docs.http.logs.summary.text: Tail GUI, intel server, wall, and build logs as JSON lines.
docs.http.logs.summary.en: Tail GUI, intel server, wall, and build logs as JSON lines.

docs.http.mtr.notes.text: IP or normalize_qname. ?cycles= is mtr -c, default 10, clamped by mtr.max_cycles.
docs.http.mtr.notes.en: IP or normalize_qname. ?cycles= is mtr -c, default 10, clamped by mtr.max_cycles.

docs.http.mtr.summary.text: Repeated path, loss and RTT like mtr --report.
docs.http.mtr.summary.en: Repeated path, loss and RTT like mtr --report.

docs.http.ping.notes.text: IP or normalize_qname. Python sockets, no shell.
docs.http.ping.notes.en: IP or normalize_qname. Python sockets, no shell.

docs.http.ping.summary.text: ICMP echo (TCP 443 fallback if ICMP is filtered).
docs.http.ping.summary.en: ICMP echo (TCP 443 fallback if ICMP is filtered).

docs.http.pmtu.notes.text: subprocess argv list (no shell); target is still user-controlled.
docs.http.pmtu.notes.en: subprocess argv list (no shell); target is still user-controlled.

docs.http.pmtu.summary.text: Path MTU via don't-fragment ping payloads.
docs.http.pmtu.summary.en: Path MTU via don't-fragment ping payloads.

docs.http.rdap.notes.text: Path rest is mostly pass-through (quoted into rdap.org).
docs.http.rdap.notes.en: Path rest is mostly pass-through (quoted into rdap.org).

docs.http.rdap.summary.text: RDAP for an IP, domain, or ASN.
docs.http.rdap.summary.en: RDAP for an IP, domain, or ASN.

docs.http.register.notes.text: example.com keeps the first label. NXDOMAIN is no-dns; NS is has-ns; NODATA/wildcard/RDAP-registered is unknown. Not a registrar cart. Rejects a bare IP.
docs.http.register.notes.en: example.com keeps the first label. NXDOMAIN is no-dns; NS is has-ns; NODATA/wildcard/RDAP-registered is unknown. Not a registrar cart. Rejects a bare IP.

docs.http.register.summary.text: DNS-delegation chessboard of a label across every IANA TLD.
docs.http.register.summary.en: DNS-delegation chessboard of a label across every IANA TLD.

docs.http.reputation.summary.text: DNSBL / domain lists, plus Sender Score.
docs.http.reputation.summary.en: DNSBL / domain lists, plus Sender Score.

docs.http.root.accept.text: HTML if Accept prefers text/html; JSON otherwise.
docs.http.root.accept.en: HTML if Accept prefers text/html; JSON otherwise.

docs.http.root.notes.text: JSON uses classify_query on the visitor address.
docs.http.root.notes.en: JSON uses classify_query on the visitor address.

docs.http.root.summary.text: HTML GUI index, or JSON lookup of the TCP peer.
docs.http.root.summary.en: HTML GUI index, or JSON lookup of the TCP peer.

docs.http.serve-start.notes.text: 401 without a session. Status bar shows ready vs building and intel uptime.
docs.http.serve-start.notes.en: 401 without a session. Status bar shows ready vs building and intel uptime.

docs.http.serve-start.summary.text: Start the intel server. Also POST /serve/stop.
docs.http.serve-start.summary.en: Start the intel server. Also POST /serve/stop.

docs.http.session.notes.text: Public. Does not leak the allowlist. Sessions are 256-bit secrets on disk; the cookie is only the id.
docs.http.session.notes.en: Public. Does not leak the allowlist. Sessions are 256-bit secrets on disk; the cookie is only the id.

docs.http.session.summary.text: Current admin user, or user: null.
docs.http.session.summary.en: Current admin user, or user: null.

docs.http.status.notes.text: Not GUI-gated. Used by the status bar. `ip` is ipv4 or ipv6; both families are also in ipv4 / ipv6. Logged-in responses add user and serve.running / serve.uptime.
docs.http.status.notes.en: Not GUI-gated. Used by the status bar. `ip` is ipv4 or ipv6; both families are also in ipv4 / ipv6. Logged-in responses add user and serve.running / serve.uptime.

docs.http.status.summary.text: Hostname, IPv4 and/or IPv6, clock, uptime, load, WSGI/ASGI.
docs.http.status.summary.en: Hostname, IPv4 and/or IPv6, clock, uptime, load, WSGI/ASGI.

docs.http.tcp.notes.text: Port range checked; host is not normalized in _plan.
docs.http.tcp.notes.en: Port range checked; host is not normalized in _plan.

docs.http.tcp.summary.text: TCP connect and a short banner.
docs.http.tcp.summary.en: TCP connect and a short banner.

docs.http.token.notes.text: classify_query: ipaddress, then ASN digits, then canonical_country.
docs.http.token.notes.en: classify_query: ipaddress, then ASN digits, then canonical_country.

docs.http.token.summary.text: Auto-detect IP, ASN (AS13335), or ISO country (AU).
docs.http.token.summary.en: Auto-detect IP, ASN (AS13335), or ISO country (AU).

docs.http.traceroute.summary.text: UDP traceroute, three probes per hop.
docs.http.traceroute.summary.en: UDP traceroute, three probes per hop.

docs.http.whois.notes.text: Domain/IP tokens are not normalized in _plan.
docs.http.whois.notes.en: Domain/IP tokens are not normalized in _plan.

docs.http.whois.summary.text: RDAP by default; legacy port-43 WHOIS with ?legacy=1.
docs.http.whois.summary.en: RDAP by default; legacy port-43 WHOIS with ?legacy=1.

docs.http_intro.text: All lookups go through respond / respond_async. Send Accept: application/json (or curl’s default) for JSON. Browsers get HTML painted by paintInspect.
docs.http_intro.en: All lookups go through respond / respond_async. Send Accept: application/json (or curl’s default) for JSON. Browsers get HTML painted by paintInspect.

docs.lede.text: HTTP API, Click CLI, and the web GUI. Regenerated by {cmd} or POST /docs. GET /docs serves the file on disk with live session chrome and does not rebuild it.
docs.lede.en: HTTP API, Click CLI, and the web GUI. Regenerated by {cmd} or POST /docs. GET /docs serves the file on disk with live session chrome and does not rebuild it.

docs.missing.text: Docs have not been generated. Run {cmd}.
docs.missing.en: Docs have not been generated. Run {cmd}.

docs.open_lookup.text: This is an open lookup service: tools connect to names you pass. Lookups have no auth. Shared /history/<id> links are public. The history rail, cache, logs, and serve controls need a PAM admin session. XSS and shell injection are not the threat model; egress to private or metadata addresses is, if this host can route there.
docs.open_lookup.en: This is an open lookup service: tools connect to names you pass. Lookups have no auth. Shared /history/<id> links are public. The history rail, cache, logs, and serve controls need a PAM admin session. XSS and shell injection are not the threat model; egress to private or metadata addresses is, if this host can route there.

gui.apex.hint.text: Check zone and mail health: parent glue, NS, SOA, MX, WWW, and SMTP, citing the same RFCs a classic DNS audit uses.
gui.apex.hint.en: Check zone and mail health: parent glue, NS, SOA, MX, WWW, and SMTP, citing the same RFCs a classic DNS audit uses.

gui.asn.hint.text: Look up an autonomous system: the organisation name, and RDAP contacts when the registry has them.
gui.asn.hint.en: Look up an autonomous system: the organisation name, and RDAP contacts when the registry has them.

gui.bgp.hint.text: Map a prefix to its origin ASN and check the ROA: valid, invalid, or not found.
gui.bgp.hint.en: Map a prefix to its origin ASN and check the ROA: valid, invalid, or not found.

gui.config.users.hint.text: Use looking-glass auth users to add or remove names.
gui.config.users.hint.en: Use looking-glass auth users to add or remove names.

gui.dns.hint.text: Ask for a record type from the IANA catalog, like dig. Leave nameserver empty to use the OS resolver (resolv.conf). Fill it in only to override, like dig @. Meta types such as ANY, AXFR, and OPT are left out. DS and DNSKEY live at the zone apex (example.com), not at www.
gui.dns.hint.en: Ask for a record type from the IANA catalog, like dig. Leave nameserver empty to use the OS resolver (resolv.conf). Fill it in only to override, like dig @. Meta types such as ANY, AXFR, and OPT are left out. DS and DNSKEY live at the zone apex (example.com), not at www.

gui.dnssec.hint.text: Walk the chain of trust from the IANA root anchors down to this domain. Unsigned names (google.com) are insecure delegations, not a break. A break is bogus: a DS/DNSKEY mismatch or a bad RRSIG.
gui.dnssec.hint.en: Walk the chain of trust from the IANA root anchors down to this domain. Unsigned names (google.com) are insecure delegations, not a break. A break is bogus: a DS/DNSKEY mismatch or a bad RRSIG.

gui.dnstrace.hint.text: Walk iteratively from the IANA root through TLD to the authoritative servers, like dig +trace. This is not a recursive lookup.
gui.dnstrace.hint.en: Walk iteratively from the IANA root through TLD to the authoritative servers, like dig +trace. This is not a recursive lookup.

gui.http.hint.text: Follow the status chain: redirects, response headers, HTTP version / ALPN, TTFB, HSTS, and timing.
gui.http.hint.en: Follow the status chain: redirects, response headers, HTTP version / ALPN, TTFB, HSTS, and timing.

gui.ip.hint.text: See who announces this address, which network it sits on, and the GeoIP country.
gui.ip.hint.en: See who announces this address, which network it sits on, and the GeoIP country.

gui.mail.hint.text: MX, SPF, DMARC, common DKIM selectors, then SMTP connect, banner, and STARTTLS.
gui.mail.hint.en: MX, SPF, DMARC, common DKIM selectors, then SMTP connect, banner, and STARTTLS.

gui.mtr.hint.text: Repeat the path and summarise loss and round-trip time at each hop. Set passes (mtr -c); default is 10.
gui.mtr.hint.en: Repeat the path and summarise loss and round-trip time at each hop. Set passes (mtr -c); default is 10.

gui.ping.hint.text: Send ICMP echo requests (RFC 792 / 4443). If ICMP is filtered, fall back to TCP.
gui.ping.hint.en: Send ICMP echo requests (RFC 792 / 4443). If ICMP is filtered, fall back to TCP.

gui.pmtu.hint.text: Find the largest don't-fragment ping that still returns, to catch PMTUD black holes.
gui.pmtu.hint.en: Find the largest don't-fragment ping that still returns, to catch PMTUD black holes.

gui.ptr.hint.text: Reverse DNS, then confirm the PTR hostname resolves back to the original IP.
gui.ptr.hint.en: Reverse DNS, then confirm the PTR hostname resolves back to the original IP.

gui.rdap.hint.text: RDAP (HTTPS JSON) is the default. Legacy WHOIS follows IANA referrals to the registry or registrar text dump on port 43.
gui.rdap.hint.en: RDAP (HTTPS JSON) is the default. Legacy WHOIS follows IANA referrals to the registry or registrar text dump on port 43.

gui.register.hint.text: Check one label against every IANA TLD via DNS. NXDOMAIN means no DNS; nameservers mean the name is delegated. This is not a registrar cart — reserved and premium names can still be blocked.
gui.register.hint.en: Check one label against every IANA TLD via DNS. NXDOMAIN means no DNS; nameservers mean the name is delegated. This is not a registrar cart — reserved and premium names can still be blocked.

gui.register.legend.text: Green is not in the DNS. Red has nameservers. Yellow timed out, is a wildcard, or RDAP says registered.
gui.register.legend.en: Green is not in the DNS. Red has nameservers. Yellow timed out, is a wildcard, or RDAP says registered.

gui.reputation.hint.text: SpamAssassin-style DNSBLs via the system resolver (resolv.conf), plus Validity Sender Score for IPv4. Public-resolver refusals from Spamhaus are query errors, not listings.
gui.reputation.hint.en: SpamAssassin-style DNSBLs via the system resolver (resolv.conf), plus Validity Sender Score for IPv4. Public-resolver refusals from Spamhaus are query errors, not listings.

gui.result.empty.text: Run a lookup. Reports paint here.
gui.result.empty.en: Run a lookup. Reports paint here.

gui.tcp.hint.text: Connect to a host and port, show RTT, and peek at a protocol banner if one is offered.
gui.tcp.hint.en: Connect to a host and port, show RTT, and peek at a protocol banner if one is offered.

gui.tcptraceroute.hint.text: Walk TTL 1–30 with TCP SYNs to a port you choose. Useful when UDP traceroute is filtered.
gui.tcptraceroute.hint.en: Walk TTL 1–30 with TCP SYNs to a port you choose. Useful when UDP traceroute is filtered.

gui.tls.hint.text: Open a TLS session and show the handshake, leaf certificate, chain fingerprints, and the peer IP’s ASN. Port defaults to 443.
gui.tls.hint.en: Open a TLS session and show the handshake, leaf certificate, chain fingerprints, and the peer IP’s ASN. Port defaults to 443.

gui.tool.against_host.text: Run a tool against this hostname.
gui.tool.against_host.en: Run a tool against this hostname.

gui.tool.against_ip.text: Run a tool against this address.
gui.tool.against_ip.en: Run a tool against this address.

gui.traceroute.hint.text: UDP traceroute like traceroute(8): three probes per hop, several hops in flight. Timeouts show as *.
gui.traceroute.hint.en: UDP traceroute like traceroute(8): three probes per hop, several hops in flight. Timeouts show as *.

gui.wait.bgp.text: Asking RIPEstat for prefix origin and RPKI ROA status.
gui.wait.bgp.en: Asking RIPEstat for prefix origin and RPKI ROA status.

gui.wait.dnssec.text: Walking DS and DNSKEY from the root trust anchors to the apex.
gui.wait.dnssec.en: Walking DS and DNSKEY from the root trust anchors to the apex.

gui.wait.dnstrace.text: Walking from the IANA root, TLD, then authoritative servers. Not recursive.
gui.wait.dnstrace.en: Walking from the IANA root, TLD, then authoritative servers. Not recursive.

gui.wait.http.text: Fetching the URL, following redirects, and timing TTFB.
gui.wait.http.en: Fetching the URL, following redirects, and timing TTFB.

gui.wait.mail.text: MX/SPF/DMARC/DKIM, then SMTP banner and STARTTLS.
gui.wait.mail.en: MX/SPF/DMARC/DKIM, then SMTP banner and STARTTLS.

gui.wait.mtr.text: Repeating the path for {n} cycles and aggregating loss and RTT, like mtr --report.
gui.wait.mtr.en: Repeating the path for {n} cycles and aggregating loss and RTT, like mtr --report.

gui.wait.ping.text: Sending echo requests. TCP on 443 if ICMP is filtered.
gui.wait.ping.en: Sending echo requests. TCP on 443 if ICMP is filtered.

gui.wait.pmtu.text: Binary-searching don't-fragment ping payloads. This can take a while.
gui.wait.pmtu.en: Binary-searching don't-fragment ping payloads. This can take a while.

gui.wait.ptr.text: PTR lookup plus forward-confirmed reverse DNS.
gui.wait.ptr.en: PTR lookup plus forward-confirmed reverse DNS.

gui.wait.rdap.text: Querying the RDAP bootstrap for this IP, domain, or ASN.
gui.wait.rdap.en: Querying the RDAP bootstrap for this IP, domain, or ASN.

gui.wait.register.text: Asking the system resolver for NS at every IANA TLD. This takes a bit.
gui.wait.register.en: Asking the system resolver for NS at every IANA TLD. This takes a bit.

gui.wait.reputation.text: Querying DNSBLs through resolv.conf, plus Sender Score.
gui.wait.reputation.en: Querying DNSBLs through resolv.conf, plus Sender Score.

gui.wait.tcp.text: Connecting to the port and reading a short banner.
gui.wait.tcp.en: Connecting to the port and reading a short banner.

gui.wait.tcptraceroute.text: Walking TTL 1–30 with TCP SYNs to the port you chose.
gui.wait.tcptraceroute.en: Walking TTL 1–30 with TCP SYNs to the port you chose.

gui.wait.tls.text: Opening a TLS session and reading the certificate chain.
gui.wait.tls.en: Opening a TLS session and reading the certificate chain.

gui.wait.traceroute.text: UDP traceroute like traceroute(8): three probes per hop, several hops in flight. Timeouts show as *.
gui.wait.traceroute.en: UDP traceroute like traceroute(8): three probes per hop, several hops in flight. Timeouts show as *.

gui.wait.whois.text: RDAP by default; legacy WHOIS uses port 43 referrals from IANA.
gui.wait.whois.en: RDAP by default; legacy WHOIS uses port 43 referrals from IANA.

gui.wall.hint.text: Select an IP or CIDR to allow, block, or challenge.
gui.wall.hint.en: Select an IP or CIDR to allow, block, or challenge.

inspect.mail.null_mx.text: Null MX (RFC 7505): this domain does not accept mail, so MX needs no A/AAAA.
inspect.mail.null_mx.en: Null MX (RFC 7505): this domain does not accept mail, so MX needs no A/AAAA.

inspect.no_icmp.text: No ICMP time-exceeded from this hop
inspect.no_icmp.en: No ICMP time-exceeded from this hop

inspect.nxdomain.text: NXDOMAIN — this name does not exist
inspect.nxdomain.en: NXDOMAIN — this name does not exist

inspect.rfcs.hint.text: The same documents a classic DNS audit cites, with section numbers on the rows that apply.
inspect.rfcs.hint.en: The same documents a classic DNS audit cites, with section numbers on the rows that apply.

inspect.unsigned_path.en: The path is not authenticated, but it is not a break.
